subject: 夏鲁寺 · 措钦大殿（夏鲁拉康）前院正面与二层汉式琉璃瓦顶
name: 夏鲁寺
sub: 措钦大殿正面 · 元代汉藏合璧
yearNote: 1087年吉尊·西绕琼乃创寺；1329年地震毁坏后，1333年古相·扎巴坚赞得元廷资助、汉藏工匠合建，现存主殿与二层汉式琉璃瓦顶即此次重建的格局，后世历代维修。年表取1333年重建。
place: 西藏 · 日喀则 · 甲措雄
coordinate_source: Wikidata Q25681（夏鲁寺）P625 坐标 29.12732, 88.99308，与维基百科条目所列 29°7′38″N 88°59′35″E 一致；寺院本体近似坐标，非本项目测绘；地图显示点新建 xz_shalu。
lede: 灰色收分的藏式殿身上，顶着几座绿琉璃瓦的汉式歇山顶——夏鲁寺是元代汉藏两种营造在同一座殿里相遇的实例。1329年地震毁寺之后，夏鲁万户长古相·扎巴坚赞得元廷资助，于1333年携汉地工匠重建；布顿大师在此住持讲学，殿与屋顶一同留到今天。
facts: 年代：1087年吉尊·西绕琼乃创寺；1329年地震损毁，1333年古相·扎巴坚赞得元廷资助重建，汉藏工匠共同营造，后世历代维修。
形制：主殿上下49间房、占地约1500平方米，底层为藏式经堂与佛殿，二层设四座汉式殿堂，覆绿琉璃瓦重檐歇山顶，檐角悬铃。
布顿：布顿·仁钦珠（1290—1364）1320年起住持夏鲁寺，开创夏鲁派（布顿派），常住弟子达三千余人；1988年列第三批国保。
caption: 夏鲁寺 · 措钦大殿正面
元 · 1333年重建
structure_checkpoints: 前院正面：底层为青灰色抹面的收分厚墙，近乎无窗，仅中央一间入口；门上出挑一座两层木构门廊（阳台），挂黑棕条纹门帘，顶部与下沿各有一道多色流苏布幔，门廊两侧各有一个小方窗（右侧带栅）。
二层退后，为黄墙汉式殿堂：正中一座重檐歇山顶最高（两层绿琉璃瓦檐、正脊中央鎏金宝瓶刹、脊端兽吻、檐角起翘挂铃），左右各一座略低的单檐绿琉璃瓦歇山顶；中央檐下黄墙上有鎏金法轮与双鹿。正面只见三座琉璃顶，文献所记第四座在后部，不可凭空补入正面。
黄墙面绘铃铎、璎珞纹（设色参考），檐下为蓝绿彩绘的多层斗栱与红色额枋。
两侧为二层回廊：红柱、彩绘额枋与栏板，左侧回廊较长，右侧接一段橙红色墙与灰墙；线稿可简化为对称的低矮回廊。
material_observations: 底层墙面青灰色抹灰（略带蓝灰），门帘黑棕条纹、布幔红白蓝黄流苏；二层殿墙明黄色，饰蓝绿铃铎璎珞纹；屋面墨绿色琉璃瓦，檐椽蓝色、斗栱蓝绿、额枋暗红；宝瓶刹与法轮鎏金；回廊柱红色；院地灰色石板。
author: Gerd Eichmann

source_note: 主图为Gerd Eichmann 2014年5月自前院正对主殿拍摄，能看清入口门廊、二层三座汉式琉璃顶与两侧回廊；补充图为同一作者的琉璃屋顶近景，用于核对瓦当、檐角兽吻、斗栱与宝瓶刹。前景经幡柱、石碑、人物在线稿中去除。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Use confident fine contours and a few finer internal structural lines. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. The white canvas will be removed later by a script; draw only the ink strokes and keep all other regions uniformly white.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.

SUBJECT: the main hall (Tsokchen / Shalu Lhakhang) of Shalu Monastery near Shigatse, seen frontally from its forecourt (Image 2); Image 3 is a close-up of its glazed-tile Chinese roofs for detail only. Draw the hall as a two-level composition: a plain, heavy, slightly battered lower wall mass with almost no windows and ONE central entrance; over the entrance a projecting two-storey timber porch-balcony hung with a striped curtain and a fringed valance (draw the cloth with a few simple folds, no solid black). Set back on top of this base, draw the upper-storey Chinese-style chapels with their green glazed tile roofs exactly as seen from the front: the CENTRAL chapel is tallest and carries a DOUBLE-EAVE hip-and-gable roof (two roof tiers) topped by a central vase finial and dragon-head ridge ends; LEFT and RIGHT of it one lower single-eave hip-and-gable roof each, so THREE roofs are visible from the front — do not add a fourth roof on the facade. Suggest the painted ornament bands on the yellow upper walls and the multi-tier bracket sets under the eaves with only a few fine lines; indicate a small dharma wheel with two deer in the middle of the central upper wall. Include the two-storey colonnaded cloister wings at both sides at reduced emphasis. Remove the prayer-flag pole, stele, incense burner, trees, people and signs.
Orientation: landscape 1536×1024.
